observations.body: The eleven go to the appointed mountain, see Jesus, worship while some doubt, and receive a commission grounded in his authority and presence.
observations.label: Worship, doubt, authority, and commission in Galilee

observations.body: The passage presents Commissioning as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Commissioning

observations.body: The passage places Jesus beside Commissioning.
observations.label: Jesus

payload.posture: Read Matthew 28:16–20 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the eleven go to the appointed mountain, see Jesus, worship while some doubt, and receive a commission grounded in his authority and presence. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
payload.title: Worship, doubt, authority, and commission in Galilee
